title: Your guest's passport photo isn't protection
caption: Most hosts think a copy of the guest's ID keeps them safe. Since Nov 20 on Airbnb, you generally can't collect it. #airbnbhost #shorttermrental #bnbhost

title: The one allowed way to see guest ID
caption: Look, don't copy: Airbnb allows an in-person ID check at check-in if your house rules say so. No photos kept. #airbnbhost #airbnbrules #hostingtips

title: A lost phone full of guest passports
caption: Holding guest ID is a liability. Canada's privacy rule of thumb: if you can't protect, don't collect. #airbnbhost #privacy #shorttermrental

title: Ontario's guest register skips the passport
caption: Ontario's 2026 guest register asks platforms for name, billing address, phone and car plate. Not a copy of your ID. #ontario #airbnbhost #shorttermrental

title: Noise monitors: the party check that's allowed
caption: Airbnb allows noise decibel monitors indoors if disclosed, never in bedrooms or bathrooms. No audio recorded. #airbnbhost #bnbhost #hostingtips
